enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed and stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and tap. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with water. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap and light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet personal time, reviewing community program notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up community program notes. Open notebook. Read notes. Turn page. Pick up pen. Underline a line. Put down pen. Close notebook. Put down notes. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open refrigerator and take out eggs and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Crack eggs into bowl and whisk. Turn on stove and pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs and turn off stove. Take toast from toaster and put on plate with eggs. Sit at table. Eat breakfast while talking to Member 2. Finish eating and clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet and take out shirt, pants, socks, and underwear. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear, shirt, pants, and socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop, notebook, and pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office as a community program coordinator, coordinating program logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Attend meeting. Take notes. Write report. Use computer to update program plans. Print documents. File papers. Organize files. Update calendar.
Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Sit at table. Open lunch container. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Finish eating. Throw away trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, meeting community partners and updating program plans
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open program plans. Read notes. Make phone calls to community partners. Meet with community partner. Discuss program logistics. Take notes. Update program plans on computer. Send emails. Print updated plans. File documents. Attend meeting. Take meeting notes. Update calendar. Organize desk.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Greet Member 2. Put down bag. Take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 2 using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open refrigerator and take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker and place pan on it. Add oil and meat. Stir and add vegetables. Stir and add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food onto plates. Set table.
Sit at table. Serve food onto plates. Pick up fork. Eat. Talk to Member 2. Drink water. Finish eating. Pick up plates. Walk to sink. Rinse plates. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Talk to Member 2. Laugh. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Drink water. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing community program notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Open program notes file. Read notes. Scroll through document. Type comments. Save file. Close file. Open email. Check email. Reply to email. Close email. Close laptop. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap and scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out and pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Put on clothes and turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time reading and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Pick up phone. Open music app. Play music. Put down phone. Continue reading. Turn page. Adjust volume. Close book. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Take off clothes and put on pajamas. Turn down bed covers. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe. Remain still. Turn to back. Close eyes.
